display_long_description:
🏅 Train Like an Olympian

Step into a lifelike Olympic 10m pistol arena right from your room, school, or training center. No travel. No expensive gear. Just pure focus, discipline, and practice.

🤖 AI-Powered Coaching

Our built-in Eagle-Eye AI Coach gives instant feedback on your stance, aim, and shot precision. Improve faster with personalized guidance that feels like having a pro coach by your side.

📊 Performance Dashboard

Every shot matters. Track your accuracy, reaction time, and progress session by session. Visualize your growth with clear metrics designed to help you reach your peak.

🎯 Practice Anytime, Anywhere

Whether you’re preparing for tournaments or just starting out, SportyXR lets you train on-demand in your bedroom, classroom, or even during travel.

🌍 Built for Everyone

From aspiring athletes in small towns to professionals aiming for the big stage, SportyXR makes world-class training accessible and affordable.
